BETA Close X Barratt Redrow PLC has announced the purchase of 12,930,000 ordinary shares for cancellation as part of its £50 million share repurchase program. These transactions occurred between April 13 and April 17, 2026, with shares bought on the London Stock Exchange from UBS AG London Branch at prices ranging from 255.3000 pence to 281.7000 pence per share. Following these purchases, Barratt Redrow holds no shares in treasury, with 1,413,696,582 ordinary shares currently in issue, representing the total number of voting rights. Disclaimer* Barratt Redrow PLC 20 April 2026 20 April 2026 Barratt Redrow plc Transactions in own shares Barratt Redrow plc, ISIN: GB0000811801 (the "Company", "Barratt Redrow") announces that during the period from 13 April 2026 to 17 April 2026 (the "Disclosure Period") it has purchased for cancellation the following number of ordinary shares of 10 pence each from UBS AG London Branch ("UBS") as part of its £50 million share repurchase programme announced on 5 January 2026 (the "Programme"). All shares were purchased from UBS as an "on exchange" transaction subject to the rules of the London Stock Exchange ("LSE"). Date of Purchase within Disclosure Period Aggregated volume (shares) Highest price paid per share (pence) Lowest price paid per share (pence) Volume weighted average price (pence) Trading venue 13 April 2026 250,000 259.1000 255.3000 256.9307 LSE 14 April 2026 250,000 262.3000 257.6000 260.0146 LSE 15 April 2026 250,000 266.3000 260.3000 263.5040 LSE 16 April 2026 250,000 273.8000 266.9000 271.2726 LSE 17 April 2026 250,000 281.7000 264.1000 270.6299 LSE To date, Barratt Redrow has purchased 12,930,000 ordinary shares in aggregate for cancellation from UBS in accordance with the Programme. Following the above purchases and cancellation of the ordinary shares, the Company holds no ordinary shares in treasury and has 1,413,696,582 ordinary shares in issue. The total number of voting rights in the Company is therefore 1,413,696,582.
